# sigma_user_attribute_tenant_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a user attribute value to a tenant organization. Composite ID `<user_attribute_id>:<tenant_organization_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_user_attribute_tenant_assignment" "acme" {
  user_attribute_id      = sigma_user_attribute.region.id
  tenant_organization_id = sigma_tenant.acme.id
  value                  = "emea"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_organization_id` (String)
- `user_attribute_id` (String)
- `value` (String, Sensitive) String value assigned to this tenant. Marked Sensitive like the other assignment values.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_user_attribute_tenant_assignment.example '<user_attribute_id>:<tenant_organization_id>'
```
